TempleRoom.title: TempleRoom
TempleRoom.description: An online Cloud Tianhou Temple hall room that coordinates shared Peace Bell rings and anchors player/chat/lantern subcollections.

roomId.description: Normalized room identifier matching the document ID.

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who initialized the room.

isPublic.description: Whether the room allows authenticated pilgrims with the room code to enter.

bellSeq.description: Monotonically increasing Peace Bell ring counter.

lastBellBy.description: Display nickname of the pilgrim who last rang the Peace Bell.

lastBellByUid.description: UID of the pilgrim who last rang the Peace Bell.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest room update.

RoomPlayer.title: RoomPlayer
RoomPlayer.description: Public 3D avatar presence, position, emote, and held incense state of an online pilgrim inside a temple room. Contains zero PII.

uid.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

x.description: Clamped world X coordinate in temple hall (-12..12).

z.description: Clamped world Z coordinate in temple hall (-12..16).

holdingIncense.description: Whether the pilgrim is holding lit incense sticks.

avatar.description: Q-Chibi visual customization map (nickname and appearance tokens only).

isActive.description: Whether the pilgrim is actively present in the room.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when player joined the room.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest heartbeat or movement update.

RoomMessage.title: RoomMessage
RoomMessage.description: Immutable live chat message or public blessing announcement in a temple room.

id.description: Unique message ID matching the document ID.

isSystem.description: Whether this message is a public blessing announcement.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was sent.

RoomLantern.title: RoomLantern
RoomLantern.description: Immutable shared blessing lantern displayed on the 3D Lantern Wall of a temple room.

id.description: Unique lantern ID matching the document ID.

ownerUid.description: UID of pilgrim who lit the lantern.

ownerName.description: Public nickname displayed on the lantern.

slotIndex.description: Slot index on the 30-slot 3D lantern wall (0..29).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when lantern was lit.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Temple room master document coordinating bell rings and anchoring subcollections.

/rooms/{roomId}/players/{playerId}.description: Real-time 3D presence, coordinates, emote, and public avatar appearance for active online pilgrims.

/rooms/{roomId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Real-time chat messages and public blessing announcements in a temple room.

/rooms/{roomId}/lanterns/{lanternId}.description: Shared persistent blessing lanterns illuminating the 3D Lantern Wall.
